Package com.csse3200.game.areas.terrain.map

Class LevelMapData

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.areas.terrain.map.LevelMapData
public class LevelMapData extends Object
The fully parsed contents of a level map file: dimensions, the legend of tile symbols, the ordered list of layers, and all spawn data. This is a pure data object with no rendering dependencies, so it can be produced and asserted on in unit tests without a graphics context.

Rendering is handled separately by TerrainFactory.createTerrainFromMap, which turns this data into a TiledMap. Collision (#16) reads tile types via getCollisionLayer().
